text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to wrap things up and 
call it a day after finishing training 
with Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew, worked up a great sweat! Ran a whole 
bunch today too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Not yet... Just one more!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —I'm definitely going to be number one!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That guy...
choice_data_list: Shall we wrap up practice soon?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "No... Let's keep going a bit longer!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
After seeing her act so defiant, how could 
I let things end like this...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I don't practice twice as hard, I won't 
be setting a good example!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that ain't it... I just gotta do 
this, or I won't be satisfied with myself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to pure guts, there's no way 
in hell I'm losing to Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer... let's go, yeah? Beyond the 
limit!
choice_data_list: Shall we go for one more run!

I think that might be going a bit too 
far...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's my partner for ya— you really 
get it, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well then, guess I'll push hard enough to 
leave my limits in the dust――

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's leave 'em in the dust!!

True to her word, even when utterly 
exhausted, Vodka continued to give her all 
in training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I never intended to turn back in the first 
place. I've decided to go as far as I can 
go.
choice_data_list:
If you push yourself and collapse, you 
won't be able to move forward at all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ugh, that's...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's true that if I collapse halfway 
through, she might leave me in the dust...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even if my mind's racin' ahead, it don't 
mean squat if my body can't keep up, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped. Out of respect for you, 
today I'll call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just don't you forget that the word 
"limit" doesn't exist in my dictionary. 
Got that?

Saying so, Vodka refrained from doing any 
extra training.
